change-language.description: Inspect text or stdin, tracked workspace files, commit messages, or task titles and bodies using the repository's bounded English-language rule. The tasks mode reads the configured tasks provider. Findings exit 1; invalid input or an unavailable provider exits 2.

label.description: With text: label the input in findings.

diff.description: With files: inspect tracked files changed in a revision range.

limit.description: With tasks: maximum number of task records to inspect.

change-verify.description: Check the local evidence of a build run against the worktree it runs in, and print one JSON verdict. --record verifies a dossier: its tree binding, changed files, policy files, consulted scopes, independent review, gate, qualification verdicts, acceptance evidence and an optional v1 workflow record. --workflow validates a separately versioned local workflow and reports progress without minting readiness. --snapshot prints the dossier skeleton for the current tree, --ref prints a file reference with its SHA-256, and --gate checks that a recorded gate session and report can replace the gate the PR finalizer would run. A gate must cover the native impacted plan, which the workspace CLI of the checked repository answers as a dry run. A restored verification report is read from the task cache of the putnami process that launched the command. Paths resolve against the Git top level. A failure prints {"verdict":"not-verified","reason":...} on one line and exits 1 with nothing on stderr; --output does not change the document. It is a consistency check, not a signed review or an access boundary, and it writes nothing.

record.description: Verify the dossier this file holds and print the verified verdict.

workflow.description: Validate a v1 local workflow and report progress without a ready verdict.
